blockers.description: Reopen evidence: None of the DoD artifacts exists: `artifacts/misc/deployment-log.txt`, `artifacts/misc/feature-flags-config.json`, `artifacts/misc/monitoring-dashboard.url`, `artifacts/logs/rollback-test.log`.
Reopen evidence: KPI "monitoring active" fails: production exports no telemetry (see IFC-032). The deployment itself is live. That part is not disputed.

To close: (1) Monitoring active (IFC-032), with its dashboard URL recorded. A deployment log and rollback evidence captured from a real production deploy. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.

Re-plan 2026-10-16 (owner ruling "Fix the 15 tasks"): not Completed, no exemption. Stays in its sprint, which is not gated yet. Needs a real zero-downtime deploy and rollback with owner approval: deployment-log.txt, feature-flags-config.json, monitoring-dashboard.url and rollback-test.log do not exist. Verified 2026-10-16: Railway production api and ai-worker have OTEL_ENABLED=true and export to the Grafana Cloud gb-south-1 gateway; ws, events-worker and ingestion-worker do not (events-worker and ingestion-worker OTEL_ENABLED=false, ws has no OTel variables). Grafana holds span metrics for api and ai-worker and ai-worker pino log lines carrying trace_id/span_id; no api pino log line has reached Loki yet.
